messages:
jamal: Heads-up — starting canary for feature fast-cache in 30m (5% -> 25% if green). Quick runbook below, please ack and call out blockers.
maria: Ack. I'll be watching error-rate, p95 latency, and cache hit ratio. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.dev/d/fast-cache
alex: On PTO but available for quick CR on eviction change. @jamal ping me when you hit the rollback path.
ryan: SRE checklist: set `max_qps` to 300 for canary, enable detailed traces for sample=1%. Alert if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m.
sasha: I can take front-line on-call for the first 20m window. If latency spike, I'll flip canary back and create incident channel.
jamal: runbook snippet for toggling flag:
```
curl -X POST https://flags.internal/api/v1/toggle \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"flag":"fast-cache-canary","pct":5}'
```
jamal: After 10m at 5% check: errors, p95, cache hit, CPU on g4dn nodes. If green -> 25%.
maria: Quick note — observed a weird bump in tail latency yesterday during low-load. I'll add a custom panel for per-node p99 now, ETA 8m.
alex: CR: PR 4921 has the eviction fix. @jamal if you see mem pressure > 80% on canary group, that PR should be reverted.
ryan: Added temporary rate-limiter in front of the canary group just in case. Config:
`ratelimit: 2k/min per key`
jamal: deploy-bot: starting canary at 1769504200 (5%) :rocket:
deploy-bot: canary started — instances: 5, route: canary/fast-cache, config-hash: a3f4e2
sasha: Watching logs, nothing red so far. p95: 98ms, errors: 0.02% at t+5m :thumbsup:
maria: p99 is 320ms on one node, marking as investigating. @alex can you prioritize a quick heap dump collector on that node? If it looks like GC, we'll throttle.
alex: On it. Uploading heap dump script to infra-runbooks now.
jamal: If anyone sees a spike, post in #incidents and tag @ryan + @sasha. I'll hold off on 25% until p99 < 250ms and errors < 0.1% for 10m.
maria: Agreed. Will update in 10.
sasha: If green at 20m, I'll signal autorestore to move to 25%. Otherwise rollback to 0% and capture traces.
jamal: thanks team — ping if anything comes up.
